name: sunday.overview
description: What the last Planning Center check found for this Sunday: when it was read, how complete it is, and each finding in brief.

name: sunday.open_needs
description: Roles that still need people and roles with no scheduled lead, with Planning Center's remaining count and how many people the check listed for each.

name: sunday.who_could_help
description: People on one role's team in no particular order (not ranked), each with what the check found: no overlap found, possible conflict, availability needs confirmation, or left out and why.

role.description: A role label from an earlier result or the question, written exactly, such as [Role 1].

name: sunday.pending_requests
description: Assignments that are pending (not accepted yet), and whether Planning Center records the request as sent.

name: sunday.rule_checkins
description: People the Church rules suggest checking in with because of how many Sundays in a row they are scheduled. A check-in is about care, not performance.

name: sunday.not_checked
description: What the last check couldn't read or didn't cover, so nothing unread is taken as all-clear.

name: rooms.conflicts
description: Room bookings on this Sunday that overlap under the church's room rules, from Planning Center Calendar.

name: followups.unowned
description: Overdue follow-ups in Planning Center People that have no owner.

name: groups.clashes
description: People scheduled this Sunday whose group meets while they serve, from Planning Center Groups.

name: today.attention
description: Items from the fictional email and calendar import that need a person's decision. Only available beside the fictional example.

name: rules.current
description: The Church rules Ozzie applied: the check-in rule, Sunday lead rules and room rules.

name: planning_center.refresh
description: Check Planning Center again now. It only reads; nothing in Planning Center changes. Use it at most once, and only when the last check is out of date.

name: drafts.prepare_note
description: Prepare Ozzie's short draft note asking one person listed for a role that still needs people. It is only a draft: a person reviews it and sends it themselves.

person.description: A person label from an earlier result, written exactly, such as [Person 1].

role.description: A role label from an earlier result or the question, written exactly, such as [Role 1].
